name: singlet_cell_calling_nucleus_vs_empty_calling
title: Nucleus versus empty-droplet calling (snRNA-seq)
description: Labels each barcode of one unfiltered single-nucleus channel as nucleus or non-nucleus and writes obs/nucleus_call_<method> with method-specific scores. The default emptydrops_intronic is a label-free multinomial null test that needs no training; dropletqc_nf and cellbender are alternatives. It needs raw/counts including empty barcodes, and raw/intronic and raw/exonic improve the calls. Do not use it on single-cell data (use cell-calling.cell_vs_empty_droplet_calling), on filtered matrices, or to choose the final cut (use cell-calling.cell_count_cutoff_selection).

dataset.description: Dataset handle: a .singlet path or URI (local path, s3://, r2://, https://) or a workspace handle.

method.description: Calling method. emptydrops_intronic is the default; cellbender and diem are model-based alternatives; umi_floor is a baseline.

sample_key.description: Obs column naming the channel; the tool runs once per level because ambient composition differs.

device.description: Execution device; auto picks CUDA when a device with enough memory is available.

seed.description: Seed for Monte Carlo draws, cross-validation and initialisation; unused by knee and umi_floor.

dry_run.description: Return estimated time, memory and device without running.

overwrite.description: Replace existing output members of the same method suffix instead of failing.

emptydrops.description: Options for emptydrops_intronic; emptydrops_cr also reads niters and fdr.

lower.description: Total at or below which barcodes define the ambient profile and are not tested.

niters.description: Monte Carlo draws per tested barcode; the smallest p-value is 1/(niters+1).

fdr.description: Benjamini-Hochberg false-call rate among tested barcodes.

test_ambient.description: Also test barcodes at or below lower for a p-value histogram diagnostic; their FDR stays NaN.

fpr.description: False-positive rate for denoised counts; does not change the nucleus call.

posterior_threshold.description: Posterior probability of cell presence above which a barcode is called.

expected_cells.description: Expected nucleus count; null lets CellBender choose.

nf_rescue.description: Minimum nuclear fraction for UMI-based rescue of barcodes flagged empty.

umi_rescue.description: Minimum UMI total for rescue, used together with nf_rescue.

rank_rules.description: Options for knee, emptydrops_cr and umi_floor.

expected_cells.description: Expected nucleus count for emptydrops_cr; null uses 3000.

umi_floor.description: Fixed minimum UMI total for the umi_floor baseline.

knee_distance.description: Select the knee-distance variant of the knee rule. In alevin-fry the flag selects the same knee-finding branch (section 4).

qc_flags.description: Quality flags written for every method; they never change the call.

mito_max.description: Mitochondrial share above which a barcode is flagged high_mito; cell-tuned default.

dataset.description: Handle of the dataset that was (or would be) updated.

status.description: completed: ran inline and wrote members; dry_run: only an estimate was computed; queued: running as a long job (see job_id).

wrote.description: Members written, for example obs/nucleus_call_emptydrops_intronic. Empty for dry_run and queued.

summary.description: Compact summary for completed runs: method, sample_key, per-sample n_barcodes, n_tested, n_called, n_limited, cut and warnings. Never raw matrices.

provenance_id.description: Id of the provenance record appended to the dataset (null unless completed).

estimate.description: Present for dry_run: seconds, peak_memory_gb, device.
